programs.title: Widow Clicquot
programs.desc: France at the turn of the 18th and 19th centuries.Twenty-year-old Barbe-Nicole Ponsardin (Haley Bennett) becomes the wife of François Clicquot (Tom Sturridge), a descendant of a family of winemakers.Although the marriage was arranged, they share great love.They also run a business together, and the woman is fascinated by her beloved's avant-garde approach to the methods of producing alcohol.Unfortunately, their happiness is disturbed by the man's sudden death.Despite the pain of losing her loved one, 27-year-old Barbe-Nicole, mother of Clémentine (Cecily Cleeve), is determined to manage the vineyard as a single woman, contrary to custom.She wants to continue implementing her husband's modern theories on viticulture and bottling techniques, and prepare her own blend of sparkling wine.To win, she must not be defeated by the capricious weather that threatens her harvest, the ruthless Jean-Remy Moët (Nicholas Farrell) who wants to deprive her of her business, or even the state that has the Napoleonic Code, which prohibits women from running a business.Based on the true story of a woman called the "grand lady of Champagne", who created the famous Veuve Clicquot brand and was one of the first businesswomen in the world.

programs.title: The Knick
programs.desc: New York, the first years of the 20th century.Brilliant surgeon Dr. John Thackery (Clive Owen) leads a brave team of young medics at Knickerbocker Hospital.The doctor introduces pioneering medical solutions while struggling with cocaine addiction.His team is making breakthroughs in medicine at a time when antibiotics do not yet exist and patient mortality is terrifyingly high.The group of distinguished medical staff includes, among others:protégé Everett Gallinger (Eric Johnson) and Algernon Edwards (Andre Holland), a promising surgeon from Europe who was included in the team against Thackery's wishes.The series is directed by Oscar winner Steven Soderbergh.

programs.title: Last Week Tonight With John Oliver 13
programs.desc: Another season of a show full of irony and sarcasm, hosted by John Oliver.In each episode, the host summarizes the events from the world of politics from the last week.

programs.title: The Pitt
programs.desc: While in the hospital waiting room, Joseph Marino experiences severe convulsions.He is immediately admitted to the trauma surgery department.Trinity Santos argues with Frank Langdon over a patient's treatment plan.A young woman, Kristi, intends to have an abortion, but Dr. Heather Collins' ultrasound measurements indicate that her pregnancy is further along than the documents indicate.A doctor struggles with a serious moral dilemma.Langdon expertly performs retrograde intubation under Robinavitch's supervision.He says he recommended him for a prestigious scholarship.

programs.title: Euphoria
programs.desc: The further fate of a group of friends who left school behind and entered adulthood.The action moves forward several years.Rue (Zendaya Coleman) is no longer a lost teenager, but a person involved in the criminal world.He goes to interrogation in connection with smuggling drugs from Mexico.Cassie (Sydney Sweeney) and Maddy's (Alexa Demie) relationship has improved, but old wounds haven't healed at all.The first woman's relationship with Nate (Jacob Elordi) develops, but not towards a happy ending.The remaining characters confront their own choices, addiction and violence.They are looking for redemption and answers to the question about their place in the world.
